vintage: Blender-behavior nowcast on Sep-2026 illustrative pricing anchors; equalization slopes industryeq.ca (crude frozen Dec 2014, condensate Aug 2026 notice); built 2026-10-02

pricing.note: Sep-2026 illustrative anchors (WCS US$73, LSB US$86, condensate US$92). Structure accepts live prices; the arb math only ever uses price differences.

heavy_into_light.read: Blenders push heavy into the light stream until the viscosity cap binds; the equalization penalty is small because the cap keeps the tender near the stream reference.

diluent.read: Blenders crowd the 350 cSt limit: every 1% of diluent cut is pure margin, so the cap is where the barrels are.

market_impact.note: Blending buys heavy and sells light: heavy demand up, light supply up, light-heavy spread pressured narrower while the window is open. Reclassified barrels also nominate in the light apportionment pool — a capacity edge on top of the price edge. Incentive strength is reported; no price move is predicted (phase-gated).

equalization.crude_scale_status: frozen since Dec 2014; Jun 2024 industry vote: maintained indefinitely, no annual review
equalization.condensate_note: recalculated monthly from market prices; Aug 2026 notice: $0.23/m3 per kg/m3

meta.notes: data_status=synthetic: pricing inputs are illustrative anchors, not live feeds; the behavioral loop is plumbing until validated against observed blender activity. Spread direction is incentive strength, not a price forecast.
blindsided: Illustrative assays (920/500 heavy, 800/5 light) are not measurements
Equalization dead band (800-825 kg/m3) not modeled in the penalty
Condensate slope moves monthly; the Aug 2026 value will age
TMX has no administered equalization bank (shipper-to-shipper only)
